scoring_justification: The checker cannot re-run the full Rayleigh-Ritz analytical model; it compares the agent-reported results to paper-derived analytical values (center displacement 53.74 µm, optimal r2/r1 0.85, tpzt/tp 0.67, pressure rise 9.87 kPa) with absolute tolerances and validates the deflection profile shape and self-consistency.

outputs.description: Deflection profile of the bimorph actuator at 100 V without gas compression, sampled at 20 equally spaced radii from 0 to 15 mm.
Key computed results: center displacement, optimal geometric ratios, and pressure rise under optimal conditions.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the reported deflection profile at a set of hidden radial points and the four numeric values in results.json against the paper's analytical solution, using tolerances appropriate for a re-implementation. The deflection profile is also checked for monotonic decrease from center to edge and near-zero displacement at the clamped boundary.

steps.description: Validate deflection profile shape (20 rows, monotonic decreasing, near-zero at clamped edge) and cross-check center displacement with results.json.
Compare reported center_displacement_um, optimal_r2_r1, optimal_tpzt_tp, pressure_rise_kPa to paper-derived gold values with absolute tolerances.
